sources.url_or_ref:
SELECT 
    d.drug_id,
    d.brand_name,
    d.generic_name,
    d.therapeutic_area,
    COALESCE(s.total_amount, 0) AS total_sales,
    COALESCE(s.quantity_sold, 0) AS total_quantity,
    i.quantity_on_hand
FROM drugs d
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT drug_id, SUM(total_amount) AS total_amount, SUM(quantity_sold) AS quantity_sold
    FROM sales_records
    GROUP BY drug_id
) s ON d.drug_id = s.drug_id
LEFT JOIN inventory i ON d.drug_id = i.drug_id
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 20

sources.title: SQL 查询记录
sources.url_or_ref:
SELECT 
    d.brand_name,
    d.generic_name,
    d.therapeutic_area,
    MAX(sr.sale_date) AS last_sale_date,
    SUM(sr.quantity_sold) AS total_qty,
    SUM(sr.total_amount) AS total_revenue,
    AVG(sr.unit_price) AS avg_price,
    i.quantity_on_hand AS current_stock
FROM drugs d
LEFT JOIN sales_records sr ON d.drug_id = sr.drug_id
LEFT JOIN inventory i ON d.drug_id = i.drug_id
GROUP BY d.drug_id
HAVING SUM(sr.total_amount) > 20000
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 15

sources.title: SQL 查询记录
sources.url_or_ref:
SELECT 
    d.therapeutic_area,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.drug_id) AS drug_count,
    COUNT(sr.sale_id) AS sales_count,
    SUM(sr.total_amount) AS total_revenue,
    SUM(sr.quantity_sold) AS total_quantity
FROM drugs d
LEFT JOIN sales_records sr ON d.drug_id = sr.drug_id
GROUP BY d.therapeutic_area
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

sources.title: SQL 查询记录
sources.url_or_ref:
SELECT 
    d.brand_name,
    d.generic_name,
    d.therapeutic_area,
    d.manufacturer,
    d.specifications,
    SUM(sr.quantity_sold) AS total_qty,
    SUM(sr.total_amount) AS total_revenue,
    AVG(sr.unit_price) AS avg_price,
    SUM(i.quantity_on_hand) AS current_stock,
    MAX(sr.sale_date) AS last_sale_date
FROM drugs d
JOIN sales_records sr ON d.drug_id = sr.drug_id
JOIN inventory i ON d.drug_id = i.drug_id
GROUP BY d.drug_id
HAVING SUM(sr.total_amount) > 100000
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 20
